title: A Study to Evaluate the Effect of a Medicine on Gastric Functions in Healthy Volunteers.
brief_summary: A 7 day study which involves 2 nutrient drink tests, an ECG, a Scintigraphy scan, and a Sect scan. This study requires the participant to make 4 visits to the GCRC in the Charlton building but no overnight stays.
raw_criteria:
1. Non-pregnant, non-breastfeeding females;
2. 18- 45 years old
3. Body mass index between 20 and 32 kg/m2
4. No alarm indicators on clinical assessment (weight loss of more than 7kg, bleeding, recent recurrent vomiting, progressive dysphagia).
5. No history suggestive of small bowel obstruction
